records.applicability: undici 6.29.0 is bundled inside the pinned scanner, npm 11.21.1, which is installed from dependency-audit/scanner with scripts disabled and run only as npm audit. Its only requirer in the bundle is node_modules/node-gyp/lib/download.js (node-gyp 12.4.0, header downloads for native builds), which npm audit does not invoke; npm's registry requests go through npm-registry-fetch and make-fetch-happen. The advisory's mechanism is an unhandled error when a response declares excessive content-encodings; it needs undici to be loaded and to receive an HTTP response. Re-measured 2026-11-04 for this renewal, on Node 20.20.2 (the major CI uses), with a preload loaded through NODE_OPTIONS so that it reaches every process and worker thread, recording every module file resolved through Module._resolveFilename and, for ESM, a module.register resolve hook (Node 20 has no module.registerHooks): the scanner's exact audit argv and cwd, and its scrubbed environment with only the probe's NODE_OPTIONS and output directory added, against the application graph on main and against its own graph, each resolved 582 module files and none under node_modules/undici, and returned complete reports. Positive controls under the same probe (requiring node-gyp/lib/download.js; requiring undici from the bundle; importing it; requiring it in a worker thread; requiring it in a child process) each recorded 95 undici files, the last two in the worker thread and the child process rather than the parent. A scanner that crashed would leave the audit incomplete, which fails closed.
records.reason: As of 2026-11-04 no npm release for Node 20 bundles a fixed undici: 11.21.1 is still the latest 11.x and bundles 6.29.0 (fixed in 6.29.1, published 2026-10-15), npm 12.x requires Node 22 and its latest release, 12.2.1, bundles 6.29.0 too, and no npm release has been published since 2026-10-15. This record RENEWS the one approved in #48 (2026-10-24), which would lapse at 00:00 UTC on 2026-11-30: a new decision on evidence measured again, not an automatic extension. Without it the scanner graph blocks validation, certification and promotion from that moment. The accepted residual risk is unchanged: that the scanner loads undici on a path the measured runs did not take. Remove this record in the same change that moves the scanner to an npm that bundles undici 6.29.1 or later; it expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-31, with the other two scanner undici records, and is not extended automatically. Frontend's matching records are renewed separately.
